title: Overtime Dogs
synopsis: What is an overtime dog? Are even dogs working overtime nowadays? In this lesson we learn how the word “dog” is sometimes used in a self-deprecatory way in Chinese.

fullText.simplified:
“加班狗”是什么狗?

    不知道你有没有听过“单身狗、加班狗”这样的带有“狗”字的词语呢?你是不是觉得特别奇怪：狗也要加班吗？
    其实，这里的“狗”说的不是真的狗，说的是人，一般指自己，用来形容自己的生活很苦很累。比如，“单身狗”说的就是自己因为单身，生活很无聊很累；“加班狗”说的就是自己因为要加班，很苦很累。你可以这么用：“女朋友和我分手了，我又变回单身狗了”、“春节还要加班，我们都是可怜的加班狗”……
    在中国，词语后面加“狗”这样的自嘲方式非常流行。除了最流行的“单身狗”、“加班狗”外，还有“作业狗”、“高三狗”、“学生狗”等。
fullText.traditional:
“加班狗”是什麼狗?

    不知道你有沒有聽過“單身狗、加班狗”這樣的帶有“狗”字的詞語呢?你是不是覺得特別奇怪：狗也要加班嗎？
    其實，這裡的“狗”說的不是真的狗，說的是人，一般指自己，用來形容自己的生活很苦很累。比如，“單身狗”說的就是自己因為單身，生活很無聊很累；“加班狗”說的就是自己因為要加班，很苦很累。你可以這麼用：“女朋友和我分手了，我又變回單身狗了”、“春節還要加班，我們都是可憐的加班狗”……
    在中國，詞語後面加“狗”這樣的自嘲方式非常流行。除了最流行的“單身狗”、“加班狗”外，還有“作業狗”、“高三狗”、“學生狗”等。

raw.synopsis: What is an overtime dog? Are even dogs working overtime nowadays? In this lesson we learn how the word “dog” is sometimes used in a self-deprecatory way in Chinese.
sentence_translations: What type of dog is an overtime dog?
Have you ever heard terms like “single dog” or “overtime dog”, which make use of the character for “dog”?
Perhaps you think it is very strange: do dogs have to work overtime?
In reality, these “dogs” are not real dogs, but people. They usually refer to oneself, to express that one's life is tough and tiring.
For example, “single dog” means that because you are single, your life is boring and tiring.
“Overtime dog” expresses that because you must work overtime, you have it tough and tiresome.
You can use it like this: “I broke up with my girlfriend, now I've turned into a single dog again”,
“Overtime during Spring Festival, we really are pitiful overtime dogs” ..
In China, this style of self-mocking by adding “dog” at the end of a word has become extremely popular.
Apart from the most popular “single dog” and “overtime dog”, we also have “homework dog”, “third year high school dog”, “student dog”, etc.
